about_short_description.short_description: Brainboard is a software company that provides engineers with end-to-end tools for managing and visually designing Cloud infrastructures.

product.name: Brainboard Platform
product.description: A cloud infrastructure design and management platform that visually creates and manages infrastructure as code (IaC) with automatic Terraform/OpenTofu code generation and embedded CI/CD.

product.name: Smart Cloud Designer
product.description: A visual design tool within Brainboard that allows users to create cloud infrastructure diagrams which automatically generate corresponding Terraform code.

product.name: Terraform & OpenTofu Modules Management
product.description: A centralized repository within Brainboard for managing private, public, and community Terraform and OpenTofu modules as a single source of truth.

product.name: GitOps Workflow Integration
product.description: A feature that connects cloud infrastructure code with Git repositories to enable continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) workflows.

product.name: Drift Detection and Remediation
product.description: A monitoring feature that detects and corrects discrepancies between the declared infrastructure code and the actual cloud environment.

product.name: Synchronized Architectures
product.description: A capability to maintain consistency and eliminate drift across multiple cloud environments such as development, QA, staging, and production.
